value.answer: Call 911 now. A child who is floppy and drowsy after a seizure needs emergency care. Stay with them, lay them on their side, and put nothing in their mouth.
value.triage: Call 911 now - do not wait for 811. Tell them your child is drowsy and floppy after a seizure. If they turn blue, struggle to breathe, or shake again, tell the dispatcher right away. Even if they wake up, go to the ER.
